name: Sandbox is turned off for every command the agent runs
description: sandbox_mode in .codex/config.toml selects the confinement agent-run commands execute under. danger-full-access removes the filesystem and network boundaries, so a command the agent composes reaches the whole machine rather than the workspace.
message: The sandbox is turned off for every command the agent runs

name: Sandbox write access is granted by an absolute or home path
description: writable_roots in the sandbox_workspace_write table adds a location to the set an agent-run command may write, on top of the project directory. Reported where the entry names an absolute or home path rather than a workspace-relative one, since only such a root reaches past the project the sandbox already grants. A root naming a home directory, a credential store, or the filesystem root turns a workspace sandbox into a machine-wide write grant.
message: writable_roots grants write access by an absolute or home path rather than a workspace-relative one
